title: Deck the Halls
credit: Tune: "Nos Galan", Welsh traditional (printed 1794); English words: Thomas Oliphant, 1862, in the form printed in the Pennsylvania School Journal, December 1877 ("Deck the hall", "Don we now our gay apparel", "Christmas carol").
